items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: And, and Oscar Moore. A drummer.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I forgot about that, he's a wonderful alto player. O'Neal Gerald. O'Neal Gerald. Okay.

Because he did one thing, I think that was Atlantic, it could have been me, it should have been me with this real fine chick.
